function exclusive_cumsum(t::AbstractArray, dim=-1)
    @debug "Exclusive cumulative sum: shape=$(size(t)), dim=$dim"
    if dim == -1
        dim = ndims(t)
    end
    s = size(t)
    cum = cumsum(t, dims=dim)
    shifted = zeros(eltype(t), s...)
    if dim == 1
        shifted[2:end, :] = cum[1:end-1, :]
    elseif dim == 2
        shifted[:, 2:end] = cum[:, 1:end-1]
    elseif dim == 3
        shifted[:, :, 2:end] = cum[:, :, 1:end-1]
    end
    return shifted
end

# --- Attention and Related Components (Fixed, Flux Compatible, With Validation) ---
struct Attend
    flash::Bool
end

Flux.@functor Attend

function Attend(; flash=false)
    @debug "Initializing Attend: flash=$flash"
    Attend(flash)
end

function (att::Attend)(q::AbstractArray, k::AbstractArray, v::AbstractArray, mask=nothing; bias=nothing)
    @debug "Attend computation: q_shape=$(size(q)), k_shape=$(size(k))"
    if size(q) != size(k) || size(k) != size(v)
        throw(ArgumentError("Dimension mismatch in Attend"))
    end
    scale = 1 / sqrt(size(q, ndims(q)))
    @einsum scores[b, h, i, j] := q[b, h, i, d] * k[b, h, j, d] * scale
    if exists(bias)
        scores = scores .  bias
    end
    if exists(mask)
        scores = scores .  (1 .- mask) * max_neg_value(scores)
    end
    attn_weights = softmax(scores, dims=4)
    @einsum result[b, h, i, d] := attn_weights[b, h, i, j] * v[b, h, j, d]
    @info "Attend completed: result_shape=$(size(result))"
    return result
end

struct Attention
    num_heads::Int
    dim::Int
    dim_head::Int
    attend::Attend
end

Flux.@functor Attention

function Attention(num_heads::Int, dim::Int; dim_head=64, flash=false)
    @debug "Initializing Attention: heads=$num_heads, dim=$dim, flash=$flash"
    Attention(num_heads, dim, dim_head, Attend(flash=flash))
end

function (attn::Attention)(q::AbstractArray, k::AbstractArray, v::AbstractArray, mask=nothing; bias=nothing)
    @debug "Attention computation: q_shape=$(size(q)), k_shape=$(size(k))"
    q = reshape(q, size(q,1), size(q,2), attn.num_heads, attn.dim_head)
    k = reshape(k, size(k,1), size(k,2), attn.num_heads, attn.dim_head)
    v = reshape(v, size(v,1), size(v,2), attn.num_heads, attn.dim_head)
    return attn.attend(q, k, v, mask; bias=bias)
end

# --- Relative Position Encoding (Fixed, With Sinusoidal Logic) ---

function (rpe::RelativePositionEncoding)(residue_index::AbstractArray)
    @debug "Computing relative position encoding: residue_index_shape=$(size(residue_index))"
    rel_pos = residue_index[:, 1] .- residue_index[1, :]'
    rel_pos = clamp.(rel_pos, -rpe.max_dist, rpe.max_dist)
    one_hot = zeros(Float32, size(rel_pos, 1), size(rel_pos, 2), 2 * rpe.max_dist   1)
    for i in 1:size(rel_pos, 1)
        for j in 1:size(rel_pos, 2)
            idx = rel_pos[i, j]   rpe.max_dist   1
            one_hot[i, j, idx] = 1.0
        end
    end
    emb = dense(2 * rpe.max_dist   1, rpe.dim)(one_hot)
    return emb
end

# --- SmoothLDDTLoss (Fixed, With Proper Bin Centers) ---

end

Flux.@functor SmoothLDDTLoss

function SmoothLDDTLoss(; num_bins=50)

end

function (loss::SmoothLDDTLoss)(pred::AbstractArray, true::AbstractArray)
    @debug "Computing SmoothLDDTLoss: pred_shape=$(size(pred)), true_shape=$(size(true))"
    bins = LinRange(0, 15, loss.num_bins)
    bin_centers = (bins[1:end-1] .  bins[2:end]) / 2
    true_dist = true[:, :, 1]
    pred_dist = pred[:, :, 1]
    bin_probs = softmax(pred, dims=3)
    l = sum(abs.(true_dist .- bin_centers') .* bin_probs[:, :, 1:loss.num_bins-1], dims=2)
    return mean(l)
end

# --- WeightedRigidAlign (Fixed SVD with Proper Rotation) ---
struct WeightedRigidAlign
    weights::AbstractArray
end

Flux.@functor WeightedRigidAlign

function WeightedRigidAlign(weights::AbstractArray)
    @debug "Initializing WeightedRigidAlign: weights_shape=$(size(weights))"
    WeightedRigidAlign(weights)
end

function (wra::WeightedRigidAlign)(pred_coords::AbstractArray, true_coords::AbstractArray)
    @debug "Computing WeightedRigidAlign: pred_shape=$(size(pred_coords)), true_shape=$(size(true_coords))"
    weights = wra.weights ./ sum(wra.weights)
    pred_center = sum(pred_coords .* weights, dims=1)
    true_center = sum(true_coords .* weights, dims=1)
    pred_shifted = pred_coords .- pred_center
    true_shifted = true_coords .- true_center
    decomp = svd(transpose(pred_shifted) * (true_shifted .* weights))
    rot = decomp.U * decomp.Vt
    aligned = pred_shifted * rot
    return aligned
end

# --- MultiChainPermutationAlignment (Fixed with Permutations) ---
struct MultiChainPermutationAlignment
    chain_indices::Vector{Int}
end

Flux.@functor MultiChainPermutationAlignment

function MultiChainPermutationAlignment(chain_indices::Vector{Int})
    @debug "Initializing MultiChainPermutationAlignment: num_chains=$(length(chain_indices))"
    MultiChainPermutationAlignment(chain_indices)
end

function (mcpa::MultiChainPermutationAlignment)(coords::AbstractArray, chain_mask::AbstractArray)
    @debug "Computing MultiChainPermutationAlignment: coords_shape=$(size(coords)), chain_mask_shape=$(size(chain_mask))"
    unique_chains = unique(mcpa.chain_indices)
    if length(unique_chains) != length(mcpa.chain_indices)
        throw(ArgumentError("Duplicate chain indices"))
    end
    best_rmsd = Inf
    best_coords = copy(coords)
    for perm in Iterators.product(1:length(mcpa.chain_indices) for _ in 1:length(mcpa.chain_indices)) if allunique(perm)
        permuted_coords = similar(coords)
        for (i, p) in enumerate(perm)
            mask_i = chain_mask .== i
            permuted_coords[mask_i, :] = coords[chain_mask .== mcpa.chain_indices[p], :]
        end
        rmsd = sqrt(mean(sum((permuted_coords .- coords) .^ 2, dims=2)))
        if rmsd < best_rmsd
            best_rmsd = rmsd
            best_coords = permuted_coords
        end
    end
    return best_coords
end

# --- OuterProductMean (Fixed with Proper Einsum) ---

function (opm::OuterProductMean)(left::AbstractArray, right::AbstractArray, mask=nothing)
    @debug "Computing OuterProductMean: left_shape=$(size(left)), right_shape=$(size(right))"
    left_proj = dense(size(left,3), opm.intermediate_dim)(left)
    right_proj = dense(size(right,3), opm.intermediate_dim)(right)
    @einsum outer[b,i,j,c,d] := left_proj[b,i,c] * right_proj[b,j,d]
    outer_mean = mean(outer, dims=(4,5))[:,:,:,1,1]
    if exists(mask)
        outer_mean = outer_mean .* mask
    end
    return outer_mean
end

    @debug "Computing MSAPairWeightedAveraging: msa_shape=$(size(msa)), weights_shape=$(size(weights))"

end

function TriangularMultiplicativeUpdate(pair_dim::Int; outgoing::Bool = true)

    TriangularMultiplicativeUpdate(
        Flux.LayerNorm(pair_dim),
        Flux.Dense(pair_dim, pair_dim),
        Flux.Dense(pair_dim, pair_dim),
        Flux.Dense(pair_dim, pair_dim),
        Flux.Dense(pair_dim, pair_dim),

    )
end

function (tmu::TriangularMultiplicativeUpdate)(pair_act::AbstractArray{T, 3}) where T
    @debug "Computing TriangularMultiplicativeUpdate: pair_act_shape=$(size(pair_act))"
    seq_len, _, pair_dim = size(pair_act)
    pair_norm = tmu.layer_norm_input(pair_act)
    left_proj = tmu.left_projection(pair_norm)
    right_proj = tmu.right_projection(pair_norm)
    left_gate = sigmoid.(tmu.left_gate(pair_norm))
    right_gate = sigmoid.(tmu.right_gate(pair_norm))
    left_gated = left_gate .* left_proj
    right_gated = right_gate .* right_proj
    multiplicative_update = zeros(T, seq_len, seq_len, pair_dim)
    if tmu.outgoing
        @einsum multiplicative_update[i,j,c] := left_gated[i,k,c] * right_gated[j,k,c]
    else
        @einsum multiplicative_update[i,j,c] := left_gated[k,i,c] * right_gated[k,j,c]
    end
    center_gate = sigmoid.(tmu.center_gate(pair_act))
    output_proj = tmu.output_projection(multiplicative_update)
    return pair_act .  center_gate .* output_proj
end

        return Dict(k => isa(v, AbstractArray) ? (device == "CUDA" ? CuArray(v) : v) : v for (k, v) in d)

    @debug "Masked average: t_shape=$(size(t)), mask_shape=$(size(mask)), dims=$dims"
    num = sum(t .* mask, dims=dims)
    den = sum(mask, dims=dims)
    return num ./ max.(den, eps)
end

function exclusive_cumsum(t::AbstractArray, dim=-1)
    @debug "Exclusive cumulative sum: shape=$(size(t)), dim=$dim"
    if dim == -1
        dim = ndims(t)
    end
    s = size(t)
    cum = cumsum(t, dims=dim)
    shifted = zeros(eltype(t), s...)
    if dim == 1
        shifted[2:end, :] = cum[1:end-1, :]
    elseif dim == 2
        shifted[:, 2:end] = cum[:, 1:end-1]
    elseif dim == 3
        shifted[:, :, 2:end] = cum[:, :, 1:end-1]
    end
    return shifted
end

function (att::Attend)(q::AbstractArray, k::AbstractArray, v::AbstractArray, mask=nothing; bias=nothing)
    @debug "Attend computation: q_shape=$(size(q)), k_shape=$(size(k))"
    if size(q) != size(k) || size(k) != size(v)
        throw(ArgumentError("Dimension mismatch in Attend"))
    end
    scale = 1 / sqrt(size(q, ndims(q)))
    @einsum scores[b, h, i, j] := q[b, h, i, d] * k[b, h, j, d] * scale
    if exists(bias)
        scores = scores .  bias
    end
    if exists(mask)
        scores = scores .  (1 .- mask) * max_neg_value(scores)
    end
    attn_weights = softmax(scores, dims=4)
    @einsum result[b, h, i, d] := attn_weights[b, h, i, j] * v[b, h, j, d]
    @info "Attend completed: result_shape=$(size(result))"
    return result
end

function (rpe::RelativePositionEncoding)(residue_index::AbstractArray)
    @debug "Computing relative position encoding: residue_index_shape=$(size(residue_index))"

    rel_pos = clamp.(rel_pos, -rpe.max_dist, rpe.max_dist)

function (loss::SmoothLDDTLoss)(pred::AbstractArray, true::AbstractArray)
    @debug "Computing SmoothLDDTLoss: pred_shape=$(size(pred)), true_shape=$(size(true))"
    bins = LinRange(0, 15, loss.num_bins)
    bin_centers = (bins[1:end-1] .  bins[2:end]) / 2
    true_dist = true[:, :, 1]
    pred_dist = pred[:, :, 1]
    bin_probs = softmax(pred, dims=3)

    return mean(l)
end

# --- WeightedRigidAlign (Fixed SVD with Proper Rotation) ---
struct WeightedRigidAlign

end

Flux.@functor WeightedRigidAlign

function (wra::WeightedRigidAlign)(pred_coords::AbstractArray, true_coords::AbstractArray)
    @debug "Computing WeightedRigidAlign: pred_shape=$(size(pred_coords)), true_shape=$(size(true_coords))"
    weights = wra.weights ./ sum(wra.weights)
    pred_center = sum(pred_coords .* weights, dims=1)
    true_center = sum(true_coords .* weights, dims=1)
    pred_shifted = pred_coords .- pred_center
    true_shifted = true_coords .- true_center
    decomp = svd(transpose(pred_shifted) * (true_shifted .* weights))
    rot = decomp.U * decomp.Vt
    aligned = pred_shifted * rot
    return aligned
end

# --- MultiChainPermutationAlignment (Fixed with Permutations) ---

end

function (mcpa::MultiChainPermutationAlignment)(coords::AbstractArray, chain_mask::AbstractArray)
    @debug "Computing MultiChainPermutationAlignment: coords_shape=$(size(coords)), chain_mask_shape=$(size(chain_mask))"
    unique_chains = unique(mcpa.chain_indices)
    if length(unique_chains) != length(mcpa.chain_indices)
        throw(ArgumentError("Duplicate chain indices"))
    end
    best_rmsd = Inf
    best_coords = copy(coords)
    for perm in Iterators.product(1:length(mcpa.chain_indices) for _ in 1:length(mcpa.chain_indices)) if allunique(perm)
        permuted_coords = similar(coords)
        for (i, p) in enumerate(perm)
            mask_i = chain_mask .== i
            permuted_coords[mask_i, :] = coords[chain_mask .== mcpa.chain_indices[p], :]
        end
        rmsd = sqrt(mean(sum((permuted_coords .- coords) .^ 2, dims=2)))
        if rmsd < best_rmsd
            best_rmsd = rmsd
            best_coords = permuted_coords
        end
    end
    return best_coords
end

    q = dense(size(pair_repr,3), ta.num_heads * ta.dim)(pair_repr)
    k = dense(size(pair_repr,3), ta.num_heads * ta.dim)(pair_repr)
    v = dense(size(pair_repr,3), ta.num_heads * ta.dim)(pair_repr)
    q = reshape(q, size(q,1), size(q,2), ta.num_heads, ta.dim)

    attended = Attend()(q, k, v, mask)

        attended = permutedims(attended, (2,1,3,4))
    end
    attended = reshape(attended, size(attended,1), size(attended,2), ta.num_heads * ta.dim)

    MSARowAttentionWithPairBias(
        Attention(num_heads, msa_dim; dim_head=msa_dim ÷ num_heads),
        Flux.Dense(pair_dim, num_heads),
        Flux.LayerNorm(msa_dim),
        Flux.Dense(msa_dim, msa_dim)
    )
end

function (mrb::MSARowAttentionWithPairBias)(msa_act::AbstractArray{T, 3},
                                            pair_act::AbstractArray{T, 3},
                                            msa_mask::AbstractArray{T, 2}) where T
    @debug "Computing MSARowAttentionWithPairBias: msa_act_shape=$(size(msa_act)), pair_act_shape=$(size(pair_act))"
    num_seqs, seq_len, msa_dim = size(msa_act)
    pair_bias = mrb.pair_bias_projection(pair_act)
    output_msa = similar(msa_act)
    for seq_idx in 1:num_seqs
        seq_act = msa_act[seq_idx:seq_idx, :, :]
        seq_mask = msa_mask[seq_idx:seq_idx, :]
        attention_bias = reshape(pair_bias, 1, seq_len, seq_len, size(pair_bias, 3))
        attended_seq = mrb.msa_attention(seq_act, seq_act, seq_act, seq_mask; bias=attention_bias)
        gate = sigmoid.(mrb.gate_linear(attended_seq))
        output_msa[seq_idx, :, :] = gate .* attended_seq[1, :, :] .  (1 .- gate) .* msa_act[seq_idx, :, :]
    end
    return mrb.layer_norm(output_msa)
end

    MSAColumnAttention(
        Attention(num_heads, msa_dim; dim_head=msa_dim ÷ num_heads),
        Flux.LayerNorm(msa_dim),
        Flux.Dense(msa_dim, msa_dim)
    )
end

function (mca::MSAColumnAttention)(msa_act::AbstractArray{T, 3},
                                   msa_mask::AbstractArray{T, 2}) where T
    @debug "Computing MSAColumnAttention: msa_act_shape=$(size(msa_act))"
    msa_transposed = permutedims(msa_act, (2, 1, 3))
    mask_transposed = permutedims(msa_mask, (2, 1))
    attended = mca.attention(msa_transposed, msa_transposed, msa_transposed, mask_transposed)
    attended = permutedims(attended, (2, 1, 3))
    gate = sigmoid.(mca.gate_linear(attended))
    output = gate .* attended .  (1 .- gate) .* msa_act
    return mca.layer_norm(output)
end

struct TriangularMultiplicativeUpdate
    layer_norm_input::Flux.LayerNorm
    left_projection::Flux.Dense
    right_projection::Flux.Dense
    left_gate::Flux.Dense
    right_gate::Flux.Dense
    center_gate::Flux.Dense
    output_projection::Flux.Dense
    equation::String
    outgoing::Bool
end

Flux.@functor TriangularMultiplicativeUpdate

function TriangularMultiplicativeUpdate(pair_dim::Int; outgoing::Bool = true)
    equation = outgoing ? "ikc,jkc->ijc" : "kic,kjc->ijc"
    TriangularMultiplicativeUpdate(
        Flux.LayerNorm(pair_dim),
        Flux.Dense(pair_dim, pair_dim),
        Flux.Dense(pair_dim, pair_dim),
        Flux.Dense(pair_dim, pair_dim),
        Flux.Dense(pair_dim, pair_dim),
        Flux.Dense(pair_dim, pair_dim),
        Flux.Dense(pair_dim, pair_dim),
        equation,
        outgoing
    )
end

function (tmu::TriangularMultiplicativeUpdate)(pair_act::AbstractArray{T, 3}) where T
    @debug "Computing TriangularMultiplicativeUpdate: pair_act_shape=$(size(pair_act))"
    seq_len, _, pair_dim = size(pair_act)
    pair_norm = tmu.layer_norm_input(pair_act)
    left_proj = tmu.left_projection(pair_norm)
    right_proj = tmu.right_projection(pair_norm)
    left_gate = sigmoid.(tmu.left_gate(pair_norm))
    right_gate = sigmoid.(tmu.right_gate(pair_norm))
    left_gated = left_gate .* left_proj
    right_gated = right_gate .* right_proj
    multiplicative_update = zeros(T, seq_len, seq_len, pair_dim)
    if tmu.outgoing
        @einsum multiplicative_update[i,j,c] := left_gated[i,k,c] * right_gated[j,k,c]
    else
        @einsum multiplicative_update[i,j,c] := left_gated[k,i,c] * right_gated[k,j,c]
    end
    center_gate = sigmoid.(tmu.center_gate(pair_act))
    output_proj = tmu.output_projection(multiplicative_update)
    return pair_act .  center_gate .* output_proj
end

    @debug "Computing TaylorSeriesLinearAttn: q_shape=$(size(q))"

struct ConditionalRoutedAttention

    num_experts::Int
    experts::Vector{Flux.Dense}

end

Flux.@functor ConditionalRoutedAttention

function ConditionalRoutedAttention(dim::Int; num_experts=4)
    @debug "Initializing ConditionalRoutedAttention: dim=$dim, num_experts=$num_experts"
    experts = [dense(dim, dim) for _ in 1:num_experts]
    router = dense(dim, num_experts)
    ConditionalRoutedAttention(dim, num_experts, experts, router)
end

function (cra::ConditionalRoutedAttention)(x::AbstractArray)
    @debug "Computing ConditionalRoutedAttention: x_shape=$(size(x))"
    routing_logits = cra.router(mean(x, dims=1))
    routing_probs = softmax(routing_logits, dims=2)
    outputs = [cra.experts[i](x) for i in 1:cra.num_experts]
    routed = sum(routing_probs[:, i] .* outputs[i] for i in 1:cra.num_experts)
    return routed
end
